en: A black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a small town with wooden buildings on both sides of a wide road. Several adults and children stand or walk along the street, and a few people pose on the steps of a corner building to the right. There is a clock mounted on a pole to the left and telegraph poles receding into the distance. The style suggests an early 20th‑century Scandinavian town. At the top center, printed text reads "Gatuparti, Vivstavarv".
